name: pivot-web-search
description: A resilient, multi-provider web search and content extraction plugin for Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock and other API providers.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API Key
tavily_api_key.description: Set to enable Tavily. Leave empty to inherit TAVILY_API_KEY from the shell, or skip Tavily entirely.

brave_api_key.title: Brave Search API Key
brave_api_key.description: Set to enable Brave. Leave empty to inherit BRAVE_API_KEY from the shell, or skip Brave entirely.

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API Key
gemini_api_key.description: Set to enable Gemini. Leave empty to inherit GEMINI_SEARCH_API_KEY (or GOOGLE_STUDIO_API_KEY) from the shell, or skip Gemini entirely.

proxy_urls.title: Proxy URLs
proxy_urls.description: Comma-separated proxy URLs to try in order. 'direct' is always appended as the final fallback — to disable that, use ~/.pivot-web-search/proxies.yaml.
